ai_language_tip: Use polite Lao (lo) with 'jao' and 'doi'; Thai is widely understood because of Thai TV, but answer in Lao; English works at hotels, tour operators and some Vientiane/Luang Prabang restaurants.
english_ok: sometimes — Fine in tourism businesses in Vientiane, Luang Prabang and Vang Vieng; rare at local shops, clinics and government offices.
politeness: Soft and unhurried: 'Sabaidee', add the polite 'jao' (and 'doi' for yes), address men as 'Than'/'Ai' and women as 'Nang'/'Euay' by age, say you call on behalf of someone; end with 'khop jai'.
name_tip: Lao people are usually addressed by given name (often a nickname); bookings go under the given name — spell it, as romanisation varies.
phone_tip: Mobile 020 plus 8 digits (020 1234 5678; +856 20 1234 5678), some 030 numbers; WhatsApp on the same number is the main follow-up channel; landlines 021 for Vientiane.
time_tip: Traditional clock: 'thum' for evening hours (1 thum = 19:00, 2 thum = 20:00), 'mong sao/baai/laeng' for day hours, 'kheung' = :30; 24-hour also used in writing — always convert and read back.
number_tip: Lao digits (໐–໙) exist but Western digits are common in writing; prices in kip are large, so thousands ('phan') and ten-thousands ('meun') matter — confirm.
avoid_calling: Avoid the long lunch break (about 12:00–13:00, government offices longer), calls before 8:00 or after 20:00, Pi Mai (Lao New Year, mid-April) and major Boun festivals when many businesses close.
closed_days: Saturday–Sunday for government and banks; shops and restaurants mostly open daily; Pi Mai (14–16 April) and national holidays close offices; festivals like Boun That Luang may close local businesses.
booking_channels: Food via foodpanda and LOCA; rides via LOCA; small businesses via WhatsApp, Facebook pages and Messenger; hotels via booking platforms; payments by cash and LaoQR through BCEL One and other bank apps.
voice_menu: Telecoms and banks use Lao IVR; hospitals, restaurants and small businesses answer in person.
callback_habits: Businesses confirm by WhatsApp or phone; delivery riders call for directions because addresses rely on landmarks.

activity.before_dialing_zh: 旅遊活動（遊船、健行、洞穴、Kuang Si 一日遊）多經旅行社或 WhatsApp，常前一天訂即可。

may_come_up.what: Tuk-tuk or minivan collection from the guesthouse included or charged
Trip runs only with a minimum headcount; otherwise shared with other travellers
River trips cancelled in high water during the rainy season

usually_asked: Trip (Mekong boat, kayaking, Kuang Si, caves) and date

beauty.before_dialing_zh: 美髮、美甲與按摩多現場或 WhatsApp、Facebook 預約；觀光區 spa 可電話訂。

may_come_up.what: Deposit for wedding (kin dong) makeup and hair, often booked weeks ahead in the wedding season
Simple haircuts and foot massage are walk-in at neighbourhood shops
Spa in Luang Prabang or Vientiane asks for hotel name for a pickup

sensitive_asked.what: Asks to send customer face photos to a personal Facebook account

usually_asked: Treatment (hair, nails, Lao massage, herbal sauna, bridal makeup)
Customer name plus the WhatsApp number for the reminder

change.before_dialing_zh: 改期取消直接打回或回原訊息即可；龍坡邦、萬榮的行程與住宿改期多走 WhatsApp。

may_come_up.what: Kip deposit kept if cancelled on the day
Owner replies to the original WhatsApp chat with a new slot
Festival dates (Pi Mai, Boun That Luang) cannot be moved

sensitive_asked.what: Asks the BCEL One transfer slip of the original deposit

usually_asked: Booked date and hour that need moving

clinic.before_dialing_zh: 公立醫院多是現場掛號排隊，私立醫院與診所可電話或 WhatsApp 預約；許多人重病會跨境到泰國就醫。

may_come_up.what: Public hospitals register patients at the counter on arrival; no phone queue
Consultation fee in kip, cash or LaoQR, and whether a Lao interpreter is needed for Thai-run clinics
Doctor suggests referral across the bridge to a hospital in Nong Khai or Udon Thani

sensitive_asked.what: Asks ID card or family book (Samanokhua) details

usually_asked: Which doctor, department or international clinic
First visit or returning with a hospital card
Patient's full name, age and sex
Phone number on WhatsApp for the confirmation

customer_service.before_dialing_zh: 電信（Unitel、Lao Telecom、ETL 等）與銀行客服有寮語語音選單，需身分驗證。

may_come_up.what: IVR in Lao, press for operator

usually_asked: SIM number or bank account in question

government_school.before_dialing_zh: 政府服務多需本人到場，電話詢問有限，改走親自到村／縣辦公室或看官方 Facebook 公告；涉及證件與戶籍（family book）的事由本人處理。

may_come_up.what: Requires visiting the office in person

sensitive_asked.what: Asks ID card or family book number

usually_asked: Office or school and the specific question
Applicant's or pupil's name and grade

home_service.before_dialing_zh: 水電、冷氣、清潔多靠熟人介紹或 Facebook；地址以村（ບ້ານ）、縣（ເມືອງ）與地標描述，門牌不普遍。

may_come_up.what: Visit fee
Technician buys pipes or aircon gas at the market and adds the cost

sensitive_asked.what: Asks payment in full before visiting

usually_asked: Village (ban), district (muang) and a nearby temple or shop as landmark
Photo or video of the problem on WhatsApp

hotel.before_dialing_zh: 飯店與賓館英語可通，平台訂房普遍；入住要護照或身分證，外國人入住須登記。

may_come_up.what: Payment in kip, baht or US dollars
Free transfer from Wattay airport or the Laos–China Railway station
Late arrival after the guesthouse gate closes

usually_asked: Room type (fan or air-con, river view)

inquiry.before_dialing_zh: 很多店家資訊放在 Facebook 粉專；節日（Pi Mai、That Luang 節）營業時間會變。

may_come_up.what: Closed during Lao New Year
Many small shops close for a long lunch

usually_asked: The exact question (hours, price in kip, LaoQR accepted)

pet.before_dialing_zh: 寵物診所主要在萬象，電話或 Facebook 聯絡。

may_come_up.what: Vaccination record
Rabies vaccine stock limited; vet asks to come on a set day

usually_asked: Dog or cat, breed, size and age

property.before_dialing_zh: 租屋多透過 Facebook 群組與仲介，看房要約，常要預付數月租金。

may_come_up.what: Six months to a year of rent paid upfront, often in cash, sometimes for a discount
Rent quoted in US dollars or kip; utilities billed separately

sensitive_asked.what: Asks a non-refundable fee before showing the house

repair.before_dialing_zh: 機車與汽車修理多直接騎去或開去店裡，手機、家電也以到店為主，改用 Facebook Messenger 或 WhatsApp 傳照片問價最常見；授權車廠（Toyota 等）才接電話預約保養。

may_come_up.what: Mechanic quotes in kip only after seeing the bike or car at the shop
Parts ordered from Thailand, takes days
Motorbike tyre and oil change done on the spot without booking

sensitive_asked.what: Asks to leave the phone unlock code with the shop

usually_asked: Whether a Thai-import part is acceptable

restaurant.before_dialing_zh: 寮國多數餐館現場入座，萬象、龍坡邦的高級或觀光餐廳才接電話或 WhatsApp 訂位；寮國新年（Pi Mai，4 月中）許多店休息。

may_come_up.what: Most local eateries and riverside beer gardens seat walk-ins and do not keep a booking list
Lao-style group dinners (sindad grill, set khao niao meals) ordered ahead with a kip deposit
Restaurant confirms only by a WhatsApp text, not by phone

sensitive_asked.what: Asks prepayment via BCEL One/LaoQR to secure a large table

usually_asked: Date and time (dinner often 18:00–20:00, kitchens close early outside Vientiane)
Headcount for the table, including small children
Air-con room, garden or Mekong riverside seating
Name in Lao or English letters plus a WhatsApp number

shop_order.before_dialing_zh: 蛋糕、花店與網路店家多以 Facebook、WhatsApp 接單，以 BCEL One 等 LaoQR 轉帳或貨到付款。

may_come_up.what: Prepayment by LaoQR transfer
Out of stock, alternative
Goods shipped by a courier branch (Anousith, HAL, Mixay) and paid on collection

sensitive_asked.what: Asks the full price into a personal account before any order details are confirmed

usually_asked: Item, size and number of pieces
Collect at the shop, rider delivery or courier branch

takeout.before_dialing_zh: 萬象外送以 foodpanda 與 LOCA 等 App 為主；在地小店多接電話、WhatsApp 或 Facebook 訂餐。

may_come_up.what: Customer can order through foodpanda or LOCA in Vientiane instead
Delivery only within the same district (muang) or for a kip surcharge
Sticky rice and papaya salad sold out by evening

sensitive_asked.what: Asks to share a bank-app OTP to finish payment

usually_asked: Dishes and portions (sticky rice baskets, larb, tam mak hoong)
Pickup time or address (village, street, landmark)

tracking.before_dialing_zh: 寮國郵政與在地快遞（Anousith、HAL、Mixay 等）多用 App 或網站查件，許多包裹寄到分店自取並在取件時付運費。

may_come_up.what: Track on the courier website or app
Parcel held at the branch; collect and pay COD there

sensitive_asked.what: Asks the receiver's ID card at collection

usually_asked: Receiver's name and mobile registered on the parcel

transport.before_dialing_zh: 萬象叫車多用 LOCA 等 App；嘟嘟車要先談價，包車與長途可電話或 WhatsApp 訂。

may_come_up.what: Agree price in advance
Van to the Laos–China Railway station or Thai border bridge priced per trip

usually_asked: Pickup point (hotel, village, landmark) and hour
